title: Super Dungeon
description: A 3D superhero high school roguelike. After curfew, fight down two seeded Underhall floors, rescue classmates, pass The Proctor's exam and silence The Librarian of the Stacks.

defaultCaptions.x: Curfew was an hour ago and my school just turned into a two-floor dungeon. The Librarian of the Stacks is NOT happy. Playing Super Dungeon.
defaultCaptions.facebook: Super Dungeon is a 3D superhero high school roguelike. Punch, dash and nova through two seeded dungeon floors, pass The Proctor's final exam, then descend into the Stacks Below to face The Librarian.
defaultCaptions.reddit: Super Dungeon is a browser 3D third-person roguelike set in a superhero high school: two seeded dungeon floors, upgrade drafts, classmate rescues and two multi-phase bosses, The Proctor and The Librarian of the Stacks.
defaultCaptions.discord: Can you get past The Proctor and The Librarian of the Stacks? Super Dungeon is a superhero high school dungeon roguelike you can play in the browser.
